svg.title: Gzip versus BGZF: to reach records in the middle of a gzip file, everything before them is decompressed; with BGZF, the index points to the one block that holds them
svg.text: Wanted: the records for positions 8,000 to 8,200
Everything before the wanted records is decompressed too
BGZF: many small blocks, plus an index
The index says which block to open; only that block is decompressed
